other_conditions: Applicant must be a Waqf Board or a registered Waqf institution possessing the property to be developed.
The institution must be solvent (not insolvent) and eligible in the opinion of the Central Waqf Council.
Projects must be approved by the Central Waqf Council and be for construction or reconstruction of economically viable buildings or non‑commercial purposes on Waqf land.
benefits_summary: Provides interest‑free loans up to ₹2 crore (or 75 % of project cost) for construction of economically viable projects on Waqf land, enhancing income and welfare activities.
documents_required: Memorandum of Deposit of Title Deed or State Government Guarantee or Bank Guarantee or State Waqf Board Guarantee
